title: Source newsletter note frontmatter (v1)
description: Structural contract for the OCR source trees findata/{The_Chatter,The_PlotLines,Points_And_Figures}/*.md. These notes are PRIMARY sources (newsletter editions), not derived concepts: producers are pdf_conv_md.py (Stage 0) and the OKF backfill for pre-adoption notes. Covers the OKF v0.2 provenance block plus the namespaced tag vocabulary (series/, publisher/, company/) and the Obsidian-publish chrome observed on hand-managed notes (permalink/visibility/language/last_updated). Supersedes okf_adoption.md SS2.2's 'no schema needed' stance, whose premise (no frontmatter) was removed by the 2026-08-19 provenance backfill.

title.description: Edition title; frontmatter title, else first markdown heading, else file stem (producer rule).

type.description: Note type discriminator — always 'newsletter' in the source trees.

items.description: Namespaced tag, same grammar as the derived trees. Source vocabulary: series/<tree-slug>, publisher/<slug>, company/<entity-slug> (newsletter_notes_adoption.md SS3).

tags.description: Machine-written tags (series/publisher always; company/ coverage optional). Flat tags are rejected.

permalink.description: Obsidian-publish permalink on hand-managed notes; producers never emit it.

visibility.description: Obsidian-publish visibility (e.g. public); producers never emit it.

language.description: Obsidian-publish language code (e.g. en); producers never emit it.

last_updated.description: Publish-chrome date on hand-managed notes; distinct from generated.at.

generated.description: OKF v0.2 §5.2 — who wrote this content and when (provenance).

at.description: ISO 8601 datetime of last meaningful content change (UTC recommended).

verified.description: OKF v0.2 §5.2/§5.3 — independent confirmations. Array (never bare map) at write time.

sources.description: OKF v0.2 §5.1 — materials this note derives from (the source PDF when kept under Reports/).

resource.description: REQUIRED. URL or bundle-relative (/Reports/...) path. Kept as a historical pointer even if the file is later removed (accepted Q5).

status.description: OKF v0.2 §5.4 — lifecycle state; absent = stable.

stale_after.description: OKF v0.2 §5.5 — absolute stale date (YYYY-MM-DD); today >= stale_after => stale.

isoDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). NOTE: unquoted YAML dates are auto-parsed into date objects by PyYAML; the validator normalizes these to ISO strings before checking.
